notes.title: Anniversary Update spotted!
notes.notes:
Greetings, dearest players!
With the release of Astrodogs for the Switch being complete, we're now working on bringing the improvements over to the PC version. 

We hope this gives you a chance to revisit your dear puppies!

Our anniversary patch will feature all improvements from the Switch version and more!

-Rebalanced all levels and boss fights
-Added level select
-Control adjustments
-Better performance
-Ship Movement Sensitivity slider to better adapt to your taste


Thank you all so much for being a part of Astrodogs, and stay tuned for more news regarding our next project! <3

notes.title: Astrodogs is Ready for Release!!
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings, space pups![/b]


As usual with us, we've kept very silent while working on Astrodogs, but be ready for it release this Thursday, April 8th!
We're very exited for you to get to play the game and tell us what you think!



[previewyoutube=geMEMTSKVLE;full][/previewyoutube]



Some of you may have already noticed that we updated the Demo 
a couple of weeks ago to reflect the final experience!
Based on the feedback we've received, we'll update it once more on Thursday!



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37978656/7d7b2cdc4508805b890e5eb81886fd2ecd09d63e.png[/img]



We hope you are as excited as we are for Astrodog's release, 
the Galaxy needs you and Woofer won't stop itself!



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37978656/889797d2a5697e576d0e6091fce2837c0f18980f.jpg[/img]



Thank you very much for your patience through the delays, as well as for being a part of our wonderful community in Discord!
If you aren't there yet, follow this link and join the conversation! 

https://discord.gg/V6tAejg

The server's going to be very lively these days!
